name: Membership political opinions
purpose: Record political opinions of members for internal campaign planning
dpia_message: Article 35 requires a DPIA before this special category processing. A DPIA is recorded as completed. This check does not generate the DPIA.

evidence.description: State the aim: political, philosophical, religious, or trade union.
Processing relates only to members, former members, or people in regular contact with the body.
Data is not disclosed outside the body without the data subject's consent.
The body has appropriate safeguards for this processing.

findings.title: Article 30 field not recorded: Envisaged time limits for erasure
findings.remediation: Record envisaged time limits for erasure on the Article 30 record for this activity.
